description_en: Queries the basic information of a file in application data, including the file name, type, and status
description_zh: 查询应用数据中文件的基本信息，包括文件名称、类型、状态等
name: DescribeFile

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the file belongs. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 文件所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The file ID, which is the `FileId` returned by the AddFile operation. You can also obtain the file ID by clicking the ID icon next to the file name on the <props="china">Application Data (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center) - Files tab</props><props="intl">Application Data (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center) - Files tab</props>
parameters.help_zh: 文件 ID，即 AddFile 接口返回的`FileId`。您也可以在<props="china">应用数据 (https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签</props><props="intl">应用数据 (https://modelstudio.console.alibabacloud.com/?tab=app#/data-center)-文件页签</props>，单击文件名称旁的 ID 图标获取
parameters.name: file_id

Data.description_en: The data field returned by the operation

CategoryId.description_en: The ID of the category to which the file belongs

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the file was added to Model Studio. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. Time zone: UTC+8
CreateTime.description_zh: 文件实际添加到阿里云百炼中的时间戳，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss，时区：UTC + 8

FileType.description_en: The file type (extension). Possible values: pdf, docx, doc, txt, md, pptx, ppt, xlsx, xls, html, png, jpg, jpeg, bmp, and gif
FileType.description_zh: 文件类型，扩展名。可能值为： pdf、docx、doc、txt、md、pptx、ppt、xlsx、xls、html、png、jpg、jpeg、bmp、gif

ParseErrorMessage.description_en: The reason for the parsing failure

Parser.description_en:
The parser type used to parse the file. Possible values:
DASHSCOPE_DOCMIND: the default document parser
Parser.description_zh:
解析该文件使用的解析器类型。可能值为：
DASHSCOPE_DOCMIND：默认文档解析器

Status.description_en:
<props="china">

For files used in document-based knowledge bases (type: UNSTRUCTURED), possible values:

</props>

<props="intl">

For files used in unstructured knowledge bases (type: UNSTRUCTURED), possible values:


</props>

INIT: Pending parsing.
IN_PARSE_QUEUE: Queued for parsing.
PARSING: Being parsed.
PARSE_SUCCESS: Parsing completed.
<note>The document can be imported into a knowledge base only after the status changes to PARSE_SUCCESS.</note>
PARSE_FAILED: Parsing failed.

<props="china">
For files used in agent application session interaction (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/user-guide/file-interaction) (type: SESSION_FILE), possible values:

INIT: Pending parsing.
IN_PARSE_QUEUE: Queued for parsing.
PARSING: Being parsed.
PARSE_SUCCESS: Parsing completed.
PARSE_FAILED: Parsing failed.
SAFE_CHECKING: Safety check in progress.
SAFE_CHECK_FAILED: Safety check failed.
INDEX_BUILDING: Index being built.
INDEX_BUILD_SUCCESS: Index built.
INDEX_BUILDING_FAILED: Index building failed.
INDEX_DELETED: File index deleted.
FILE_IS_READY: File is ready.
<note>Q&A is available only after the status changes to FILE_IS_READY.</note>
FILE_EXPIRED: File expired.
<note>The file is valid only for the current user session. After the user closes the session, the file expires (maximum validity period: 7 days). Long-term retention is not supported.</note>
</props>
Status.description_zh:
<props="china">

用于文档类知识库的文件（类型为UNSTRUCTURED），状态可能值为：

</props>

<props="intl">

用于非结构化知识库的文件（类型为UNSTRUCTURED），状态可能值为：


</props>

INIT: 待解析。
IN_PARSE_QUEUE：解析队列排队中。
PARSING: 解析中。
PARSE_SUCCESS：解析完成。
<note>必须等到状态为PARSE_SUCCESS才能将文档导入知识库。</note>
PARSE_FAILED：解析失败。

<props="china">
用于智能体应用会话交互 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/file-interaction)的文件（类型为SESSION_FILE），状态可能值为：

INIT: 待解析。
IN_PARSE_QUEUE：解析队列排队中。
PARSING: 解析中。
PARSE_SUCCESS：解析完成。
PARSE_FAILED：解析失败。
SAFE_CHECKING: 安全检测中。
SAFE_CHECK_FAILED: 安全检测失败。
INDEX_BUILDING：索引构建中。
INDEX_BUILD_SUCCESS：索引构建成功。
INDEX_BUILDING_FAILED：索引构建失败。
INDEX_DELETED：文件索引已删除。
FILE_IS_READY：文件准备完毕。
<note>必须等到状态为FILE_IS_READY才能进行问答。</note>
FILE_EXPIRED：文件过期。
<note>仅用户当前会话有效，用户关闭会话后文件过期（最长有效期为7天），不支持长期保存。</note>
</props>

Tags.description_en: The list of tags associated with the file. A file can be associated with multiple tags
Tags.description_zh: 文件关联的标签列表，一个文件支持关联多个标签

Status.description_en: The status code returned by the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功，可能值为：
true：成功。
false：失败
